settings.title: Choose the piece
settings.body: The hoodie or the crewneck. Same fleece, same heart, same softness - choose whichever feels right for them.

settings.title: Write your note
settings.body: A few words - or just a name. We hand-copy it onto a card that goes in the box. You don't need to have the right words.

settings.title: We send it
settings.body: Straight to their door. No price, no packing slip. Just something soft, arriving when the day was hard.
